name: validate_prow_job_runs_counts
description: Compare prow_job_runs row counts per day for last 120 days between original and _new table. Returns only mismatches.
query: SELECT COALESCE(o.day, n.day) AS day, COALESCE(o.cnt, 0) AS original_count, COALESCE(n.cnt, 0) AS new_count, COALESCE(o.cnt, 0) - COALESCE(n.cnt, 0) AS diff FROM (SELECT DATE(timestamp) AS day, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM prow_job_runs WHERE timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '120 days' GROUP BY 1) o FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT DATE(timestamp) AS day, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM prow_job_runs_new WHERE timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '120 days' GROUP BY 1) n ON o.day = n.day WHERE COALESCE(o.cnt, 0) != COALESCE(n.cnt, 0) ORDER BY 1
